_note: Episode continuity is immutable production input. Changes require human review and a new canon lock.

Keen.rule: Keen is bare-wristed before the approved 3.B3.S1 handoff. In the approved take Mum visibly fits both vacant aged-gold cuffs; every later shot keeps both cuffs on his wrists until Aida visibly installs the crystals.
The cuffs remain vacant through the opening of Aida's award shot; only Aida's visible crystal installation changes them to crystal-set.

lostItems.name: Keen's sailboat
lostItems.sourceEvidence: Misty confirms that Keen's boat is gone after the storm rescue.

referenceRequiredProps.rule: Any shot whose approved direction uses Keen's sailboat must bind an approved prop:keen_sailboat provider reference. Prompt wording, a scene plate, or inherited pixels do not replace dedicated prop authority.

Every post-departure boat shot must bind the approved wide departure frame as prop:keen_sailboat_departure_state. It is the visual authority for the loaded cargo arrangement established while Keen leaves Mum: satchel, map, rolled blanket and food pouch remain aboard in their fixed cluster until an approved action visibly changes them.
